lines.text: Before dawn in Uttarakhand.
Forty-one workers are deep inside the Silkyara tunnel when part of it collapses.
They're alive.
Sixty metres of rock now stand between them and the way out.
Behind it: two kilometres of finished tunnel, eight and a half metres high.
The lights still work. And so does one pipe.
Through it come oxygen, puffed rice and dry fruit.
To stay sane, they walk the tunnel and do yoga.
A twenty-five-tonne auger drill is flown in from Delhi by the air force.
The plan: push a steel pipe through the rubble, wide enough to crawl through.
Day nine. A narrow pipe gets through first, and the first hot meal goes in: khichdi, packed in bottles.
The next day, a camera crawls down the same pipe. For the first time, the world sees their faces.
The big drill chews in. Twenty metres. Thirty. Forty-seven.
Day thirteen, it hits steel, and its blades snap off inside the pipe.
About ten metres short.
So a second rig starts drilling straight down, from the top of the mountain.
Then they call in twelve rat-hole miners.
Rat-hole mining is so dangerous that it was banned in Meghalaya's coal mines in 2014.
One after another, they crawl into the pipe and dig with hammers and chisels.
Twelve metres, in about a day.
Day seventeen, just after seven in the evening: they break through.
Then all forty-one come out, one by one, on wheeled stretchers.
Forty-one men. Forty-one ambulances waiting outside.
Three months later, bulldozers come for the house of the man who led those miners, Vakeel Hasan.
Delhi's development authority says the house stood on its land.
He got forty-one men out of a mountain. That night, his family slept on the street.

shots.name: mountain
shots.note: Before dawn: tilt down off the snow range, over the forested slope, to the lit mouth.

shots.name: work
shots.note: The night shift: a slow push down a busy bore as the dumper drives in.

shots.name: chai
shots.note: Tea break. Grit patters on his helmet, the lamps dip, he looks up.

shots.name: collapse
shots.note: The crown comes down between the crew and the way out; the dust takes the bore.

shots.name: alive
shots.note: Later. Headlamps in the dust; the power stutters back on the word; forty-one faces.

shots.name: plug_throw
shots.note: Rescue side of the plug: the engineer winds up and flings the tape's hook up into the gap.

shots.name: plug_catch
shots.note: Trapped side: the hook shoots out of the gap, slides down, he catches it on 'Sixty'; 60 m lands.

shots.name: plug_wide
shots.note: Pull out and track along the cutaway: the lit trapped men, 60 m of rubble, the way out.

shots.name: tunnel_space
shots.note: Inside the surviving bore: move through the workers and look up to the ribbed crown.

shots.name: lifeline_lights
shots.note: At the rubble, his headlamp in our eyes; he clicks it off on 'lights' and looks up: the lamps burn all the way down the bore.

shots.name: lifeline_pipe
shots.note: The water main out of the rubble: he spins the gate valve open and water bursts out on 'pipe'.

shots.name: feed_out
shots.note: X-ray of the supply pipe through the rubble: blue oxygen lines race through it, a jar of puffed rice rides the air.

shots.name: feed_in
shots.note: Inside: jars shoot out of the supply line on puffs of air: puffed rice into one man's hands, dry fruit into the other's.

shots.name: laps
shots.note: Days later: pairs and singles walking laps away from us down the lit bore, lamps receding.

shots.name: yoga
shots.note: Yoga on cardboard mats: the leader in front, the group copies; one wobbles and topples.

shots.name: airlift_hold
shots.note: Inside the Hercules: the 25-tonne auger rig chained in the hold; the floor flexes; 25 t lands on 'tonne'.

shots.name: airlift_sky
shots.note: Air to air: the grey IAF Hercules, belly sagging, props a blur, dropping into the valley.

shots.name: airlift_ramp
shots.note: On the airstrip: it rolls to a halt, nose dips, the ramp drops on 'force' and the rig is there.

shots.name: plan_rig
shots.note: The auger rig set up at the rescue face of the rubble, its crew at the controls.

shots.name: rig_push
shots.note: Low along the casing: the rams shove, the spinning auger and the pipe bite into the heap.

shots.name: pipe_crawl
shots.note: From inside a spare 800 mm pipe: a rescuer squeezes in on hands and knees, squashed flat, and grins.

shots.name: day9_tally
shots.note: Day nine: the ninth chalk tally on the lining wall.

shots.name: narrow_pipe
shots.note: A 6-inch pipe noses out of the rubble with a puff of dust; the men lean in.

shots.name: khichdi_cook
shots.note: Outside at night under the tarp: the cook folds a big degchi of khichdi with both hands on the karchi; steam backlit by the bulb, the lit tunnel mouth soft behind him. Slow push in.

shots.name: khichdi_pour
shots.note: Overhead food insert at the bottling table: a karchi tips khichdi into an open wide-mouth bottle he steadies; it plops, the bottle fills; filled, capped bottles soft in the foreground.

shots.name: khichdi_bottle
shots.note: Inside, reverse angle over the narrow pipe: the bottle slides out into his hands; he lifts it by his face, cap off, steam.

shots.name: scope_pipe
shots.note: Inside the 6-inch pipe, riding just behind the endoscope head: its LED ring lights the rusty steel and the weld seams racing past; the mouth is a warm disc of light ahead that grows.

shots.name: scope_faces
shots.note: The endoscope's view as it noses out: the men crowd the lens, laughing and waving.

shots.name: tv_screen
shots.note: Outside at night, over the shoulders of the official and a mother: the site monitor shows the men waving.

shots.name: tv_react
shots.note: From beside the monitor: the mother and brother, lit by the screen, break into tears; the official smiles.

shots.name: auger_chew
shots.note: X-ray of the plug at the rescue face: the casing's cutting head grinds into a boulder and it bursts on "chews"; spoil rides back along the spinning flight.

shots.name: auger_ride
shots.note: Riding with the nose through the cut-open rubble: it surges and stalls, the counter on it lands on 20, 30, 47.

shots.name: tally13
shots.note: Day thirteen: the same chalk tally, now twelve marks; the thirteenth goes up.

shots.name: steel_hit
shots.note: X-ray at the nose: the head grinds into a buried rib girder; sparks fountain at us.

shots.name: blades_snap
shots.note: Close on the flight: on "snap" it shears, a piece flies at us, the rest wedge in the casing and it jams dead; pull back along the pipe on "inside the pipe".

shots.name: gap_short
shots.note: From behind the jammed head, down the rubble still in the way to the trapped side's lamps; a line grows from the head to the far face and the counter lands on 10 m on "ten".

shots.name: ridge_rig
shots.note: The mountain top over the trapped section: a crawler drill rig, its mast against the sky; the operator throws the lever on "rig", the rotary head spins and feeds down on "drilling", mud spits from the collar.

shots.name: drill_down
shots.note: X-ray down the cut face: from the bit a few metres in, the camera plunges along the glowing planned line through about a hundred metres of rock to the trapped men's lamps below.

shots.name: miners_arrive
shots.note: Day at the portal: twelve rat-hole miners walk to the mouth with their own tools, taslas on their heads; a pickup has just pulled up behind; officials step aside. The count lands on 12 on "twelve".

shots.name: rathole_crawl
shots.note: The bottom of a rat-hole pit in Meghalaya: a miner with a headlamp crawls into a hole barely higher than his knees; grit sifts from its roof on "dangerous".

shots.name: pit_tape
shots.note: At the rim: an official walks red-and-white barrier tape across the pit on "banned".

shots.name: ngt_notice
shots.note: The National Green Tribunal's order on the post, the taped-off pit behind it; push in to "April 2014".

shots.name: pipe_enter
shots.note: The auger gone, the escape pipe's mouth over a timber platform, the air duct snaking in; one after another the miners slide in head first.

shots.name: pipe_dig
shots.note: Inside the pipe, from the rock face: a miner lying in the tube, headlamp on, hammers a chisel into the rock on "dig", "hammers", "chisels"; chips fly; behind him another drags spoil back in a tasla.

shots.name: hand_dig
shots.note: X-ray: the blades out, two miners lie in the pipe's nose; it creeps through the last of the rubble. "12 m" lands on "Twelve", "~24 h" on "day".

shots.name: tally17
shots.note: Day seventeen: sixteen chalk marks and the seventeenth going up.

shots.name: watch_705
shots.note: Night at the portal: close on an official's raised wrist; his watch says just after seven.

shots.name: break_through
shots.note: From the trapped side: the last rubble tumbles away on "break", light floods onto the digger's face; a trapped worker's hand reaches in and grips his on "through".
